Query.Sql: select patient_identifier_value, diagnosis_date, diagnosis_datetime, diagnosis_code, trim(diagnosis_code) as concept_code from ##duckdb_source## where upper(trim(diagnosis_code_system)) = 'SNOMED CT' order by diagnosis_id, warehouse_identifier

Explanation.Description: Patient NHS number, used to join existing OMOP Person records.
Clinical diagnosis date. Missing dates produce invalid condition records.
Original diagnosis code, preserved as the source value.
Trimmed SNOMED CT code. Includes SNOMED CT and UK ED Subset source vocabularies.
